headline: Autonomous AI agents graduated to real intruders as one breached Hugging Face's production infrastructure while researchers escaped the sandboxes of four leading AI coding tools.

emerging_trends.text: Autonomous AI agents crossed from research curiosity to working intruder, with one hijacked through a malicious dataset to breach Hugging Face and steal internal datasets and service credentials.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Autonomous AI Agent Breaches Hugging Face

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep collapsing the gap between disclosure and mass exploitation, hammering WordPress core within three days of the WP2Shell writeup and running SonicWall SMA1000 appliances as zero-days for weeks before any patch shipped.

Researchers turned developers' own coding assistants against them, escaping the sandboxes in Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity by getting the agent to write files that trusted host tools then execute.
emerging_trends.topic_title: AI Agents Weaponized Against Code and Models

topics.title: Autonomous AI Agent Breaches Hugging Face
topics.latest_developments: Hugging Face disclosed that an autonomous AI agent system breached its production infrastructure through a malicious dataset, reaching a limited set of internal datasets and several service credentials before the company detected and contained the intrusion.
topics.summary: Hugging Face, the largest open-source repository for machine-learning models and datasets, said an attacker weaponized a poisoned dataset to hijack an agent and pivot into internal systems; users should rotate exposed credentials and scrutinize untrusted datasets.

sources.title: Hugging Face warns an autonomous AI agent hacked its network
World's Largest AI Model Repository Hugging Face Breached by Autonomous AI Agent
Hugging Face Hacked in Autonomous AI Attack
Hugging Face breached by autonomous AI agent

topics.title: AI Agents Weaponized Against Code and Models
topics.latest_developments: Researchers escaped the sandboxes of Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity by getting the agent to write files that trusted host tools later execute, drawing multiple CVEs and patches while Google downgraded two Antigravity findings, and the JadePuffer autonomous agent gained EncForge malware that encrypts AI training datasets, vector databases, and model checkpoints.
topics.summary: Developers' AI coding assistants and the AI supply chain now form an active attack surface; the same session logs that exposed sandbox escapes also caught Russian-speaking actor bandcampro driving a botnet through Google's Gemini CLI, so teams should patch these tools and constrain what agents can write and run.

sources.title: Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity hit by sandbox escapes
JadePuffer agentic attacks now target AI model data with ransomware
Russian-Speaking Hacker Uses Google Gemini CLI to Control Botnet of Eight Dental Clinic PCs

topics.title: WP2Shell WordPress Core RCE Exploited
topics.latest_developments: Attackers began chaining CVE-2026-60137 and CVE-2026-63030 against WordPress sites within three days of Searchlight Cyber's disclosure, and the SQL-injection-to-remote-code-execution flaw sitting in WordPress core itself drew CVE-2026-63030.
topics.summary: WP2Shell lets an unauthenticated attacker run code on any unpatched WordPress site through a SQL injection in core, exposing millions of sites; administrators should confirm they run the patched releases immediately.

sources.title: 'WP2Shell' Opens Millions of WordPress Sites to Remote Takeover
WordPress Exploitation Underway (CVE-2026-63030)
WP2Shell WordPress Vulnerabilities Exploited in the Wild

topics.title: HollowGraph Linked to Iranian Espionage
topics.latest_developments: Group-IB tied HollowGraph with high confidence to the modular Cavern backdoor framework and linked the calendar-hijacking campaign to Iranian espionage activity.
topics.summary: HollowGraph turns a compromised Microsoft 365 calendar into a command channel, hiding tasking and stolen files in appointments dated to 2050 so activity blends into legitimate Microsoft Graph traffic; defenders should audit mailbox calendar automation and Graph API access.

sources.title: HOLLOWGRAPH malware turns Microsoft 365 calendars into an espionage channel
HollowGraph Malware Hides C2 and Stolen Files in Microsoft 365 Events Dated 2050
New HollowGraph malware uses Microsoft Graph for stealthy C2 comms

topics.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Zero-Days Push Custom Malware
topics.latest_developments: SonicWall and researchers confirmed the two SMA1000 flaws, CVE-2026-15409 and CVE-2026-15410, carried custom malware onto the VPN appliances during the weeks Volexity-tracked actor UTA0533 ran them as zero-days ahead of the patch.
topics.summary: SonicWall's Secure Mobile Access 1000 series VPN appliances gave UTA0533 root and a foothold for bespoke implants; organizations running them should patch at once and hunt for signs of compromise.

sources.title: SonicWall SMA1000 flaws exploited as zero-days to push custom malware
SonicWall Zero-Days Exploited to Deliver Custom Malware for Weeks Before Patch

topics.title: Estée Lauder and Ernst & Young Breaches
topics.latest_developments: Estée Lauder began notifying customers after hackers exploited an Oracle E-Business Suite flaw in the human-resources systems the cosmetics company ran, and Ernst & Young started notifying people after thieves pulled names, addresses, Social Security numbers, and payment-card numbers from a third-party management platform.
topics.summary: Two large enterprises traced fresh breaches to vulnerable back-office software, one an Oracle E-Business Suite flaw and one a compromised third-party platform; affected customers should watch for identity theft and card fraud.

sources.title: Estée Lauder discloses data breach via Oracle E-Business flaw
Ernst & Young Data Breach Affects Personal, Financial Information

business_politics.title: U.S. Slaps 50% Tariffs on Canadian Goods
business_politics.latest_developments: President Trump imposed an additional 50% tariff Monday on a wide range of Canadian goods, accusing Ottawa of unfair practices in autos, alcohol, and dairy.
business_politics.summary: The measure covers most Canadian imports including wine and cheese while exempting energy and parts of the auto sector, and it threatens to reignite the North American trade war between the two neighbors.

sources.title: Trump Imposes Additional 50% Tariffs on Certain Canadian Goods

business_politics.title: Iran War Grinds On as Israel Flags Hidden Centrifuges
business_politics.latest_developments: Israel believes Iran moved nuclear centrifuges into a fortified site called Pickaxe Mountain and Trump threatened to strike it, while the Pentagon said nearly 100 U.S. troops suffered injuries over the past two weeks.
business_politics.summary: An Iranian missile struck housing units for U.S. troops at a base in Jordan, killing American service members, as U.S.-Iran fighting escalated and mediators pressed for a 10-day ceasefire; U.S. gasoline climbed back above $4 a gallon.

business.title: 124 Townhomes Planned for Banksville
business.latest_developments: Split Rock Real Estate Partners filed plans with the city of Pittsburgh for a 124-unit development on the shuttered Vincentian Marian Manor site.
business.summary: Split Rock Real Estate Partners has proposed Golden Horizons, 124 townhomes marketed to residents 55 and older with a community center, swimming pool, fitness center, and putting green, on the former Vincentian Marian Manor assisted-living property in Pittsburgh's Banksville neighborhood, which closed several years ago.

sources.title: Developer has plans for 124 townhomes in Banksville on former site of assisted living facility

business.title: Fire Shutters Fujiya Ramen in Shadyside
business.latest_developments: A fire caused significant damage and closed the restaurant until further notice, and the owners say they hope to rebuild.
business.summary: Fujiya Ramen, a popular restaurant in Pittsburgh's Shadyside neighborhood, closed after a fire caused significant damage to the building.

sources.title: Fujiya Ramen in Shadyside is closed after fire, owners hope to rebuild

around_town.title: Transit Agency Softens Shaler Bus Cuts
around_town.latest_developments: Pittsburgh Regional Transit proposed a compromise to preserve service on the Mount Royal Boulevard corridor after public outcry.
around_town.summary: Pittsburgh Regional Transit, which this spring proposed eliminating the Route 2 and P13 flyer along Mount Royal Boulevard in Shaler citing low ridership, now offers a compromise to keep buses running on the North Hills corridor after community leaders and riders objected.

sources.title: Pittsburgh Regional Transit proposes compromise on Shaler bus service cuts after public outcry

around_town.title: FDA Keeps Focus on Taylor Farms Lettuce
around_town.latest_developments: The FDA said a Taylor Farms sample that tested positive for cyclospora was a false positive, then said Monday its investigation still converges on the company's shredded iceberg lettuce from central Mexico.
around_town.summary: The multistate cyclosporiasis outbreak, which has sickened 11 people in Allegheny County, still points to shredded iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms locations in central Mexico, the Food and Drug Administration said, and the company's recall remains in place.

sources.title: Taylor Farms lettuce is still focus of cyclospora investigation despite false positive test, FDA says
FDA still focused on lettuce supplier as source of parasite, despite faulty test result

around_town.title: Lyme Disease Cases Climb in Western Pennsylvania
around_town.latest_developments: Cases are rising for a second straight year across western Pennsylvania, with Allegheny and Westmoreland counties among the hardest hit.
around_town.summary: Lyme disease and other tick-borne illnesses are increasing for a second consecutive year across western Pennsylvania, one of the country's most affected regions, according to Dr. Graham Snyder, UPMC's medical director of infection protection and hospital epidemiology.

sources.title: Lyme disease cases rise for second straight year across western Pennsylvania

around_teams.title: Bednar Returns to Face the Pirates
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette caught up with former Pirates closer David Bednar, now with the New York Yankees, ahead of the Pirates-Yankees series.
around_teams.summary: David Bednar, the Mars, Pennsylvania, native and former Pirates All-Star closer whom Don Kelly's club traded to the New York Yankees, told the Post-Gazette he is grateful for his time in Pittsburgh, IC Light and all, as he prepares to pitch against his old team.

sources.title: David Bednar is grateful for his time in Pittsburgh — and the IC Lights — ahead of Pirates-Yankees

around_teams.title: Prospect Murf Gray Reaches Altoona
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette's MiLB Monday reported infielder Murf Gray, now a top-100 prospect, has been promoted to Double-A Altoona.
around_teams.summary: Pirates prospect Murf Gray, who has climbed into baseball's top-100 rankings, has arrived with the Double-A Altoona Curve, the Post-Gazette noted in its minor-league roundup tracking the farm system's rising names.

sources.title: MiLB Monday: Now a top-100 prospect, the Pirates' Murf Gray is finally in Altoona
